detail.longDescription: 🦗 NEW: Scientists reconstructed likely calls from 20 fossilized # insects representing nine # Jurassic species found in Inner # Mongolia and # China . Most produced low-frequency # sounds similar to modern # crickets , while Sigmaboilus peregrinus may have chirped at 20-22 kHz. The # findings suggest ultrasonic # communication existed before # bats and may have evolved in response to several # predators . 👉 https://www. smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/ scientists-recreated-the-long-lost-chirps-of-jurassic-insects-listen-to-the-simulated-soundscape-of-165-million-years-ago-180989445/ # paleontology # dinosaurs # katydids # evolution # acoustics # fossils # science # biology # ai # nature # research # entomology # research
